panels.description: The group climbs the conduit while TJ's detached head slips beneath a low brace. Keep the head's route and the people above readable.
Water reaches a red flood mark on the conduit wall. Keep the mark and rising water dominant.
B11 slips on the wet walkway and Alex catches his articulated arm. Keep their grip clear and leave upper tunnel space.
Alex pulls B11 upward as the flood gate closes below them. Keep the closing gate visible in depth and leave upper space for the sound.

items.speaker: B11
items.text: I once mapped a flood route backward for six hours.

items.speaker: B11
items.text: It taught me to stop calling the wall a door.
